home.whySubtitle: A premier European destination for individuals and businesses
home.why1Desc: Maximum personal income tax of 10% and corporate tax of 10%.

home.why3Desc: Outstanding healthcare, safety, and a pristine mountain environment.
home.why4Desc: No inheritance tax, no wealth tax, and no capital gains tax on financial investments.

passiveResidency.heroSubtitle: Live in Andorra without working locally. The ideal solution for investors, retirees, and digital nomads seeking Europe's most tax-friendly environment.
passiveResidency.benefit1Desc: One of the lowest personal income tax rates in Europe, capped at just 10%.
passiveResidency.benefit2Desc: No wealth, inheritance, or capital gains taxes on financial investments.
passiveResidency.benefit3Desc: Full access to Spain and France, with Schengen Area travel rights.
passiveResidency.benefit4Desc: Access to Andorra's excellent public and private healthcare system.
passiveResidency.req2: Clean criminal record from country of origin
passiveResidency.req4: Minimum 90 days/year physical presence in Andorra
passiveResidency.req5: Investment of €400,000 in Andorran assets or equivalent bank guarantee
passiveResidency.ctaTitle: Ready to Become a Passive Resident?
passiveResidency.ctaSubtitle: Our team will guide you through every step of the application. Book your free consultation now.

activeResidency.heroSubtitle: Live and work in Andorra. Perfect for entrepreneurs, freelancers, and professionals looking to establish themselves in a low-tax European jurisdiction.
activeResidency.benefit1Desc: Legally live and work in Andorra, including running your own business.
activeResidency.benefit2Desc: 10% corporate tax, 10% personal income tax — some of Europe's lowest rates.
activeResidency.benefit3Desc: Growing tech and business community with excellent infrastructure.
activeResidency.benefit4Desc: Extend residency to your spouse and dependent children.
activeResidency.req1: Valid employment contract or business activity in Andorra
activeResidency.req3: Health insurance or enrolment in CASS (Andorran social security)
activeResidency.ctaTitle: Ready to Live & Work in Andorra?
activeResidency.ctaSubtitle: Let our experts handle the paperwork while you focus on your future. Book a free consultation today.

companyFormation.heroSubtitle: Incorporate your business in Andorra and benefit from one of Europe's most competitive corporate tax regimes, full legal compliance, and a strategic European location.
companyFormation.benefit1Desc: A flat 10% corporate tax rate, with additional incentives for new businesses.
companyFormation.benefit2Desc: No withholding tax on dividends distributed to non-resident shareholders.
companyFormation.benefit3Desc: Trade freely with Spain and France under a special EU trade agreement.
companyFormation.benefit4Desc: Transparent, modern commercial law based on European standards.
companyFormation.type1Desc: The most common structure, equivalent to an LLC. Minimum share capital of €3,000.
companyFormation.type2Desc: A public limited company. Minimum share capital of €60,000. Ideal for larger enterprises.
companyFormation.req4: Business activity description and government approval
companyFormation.ctaSubtitle: We handle the entire process from start to finish. Get in touch for a free consultation.
